name: Meetzi Booking Automation API
description: All seven API key authenticated endpoints under /v1 for Zapier and custom server integrations. Validate an account, list booking pages, read recent bookings, and subscribe to booking events. Booking data is scoped to pages owned by the key owner. This reference does not cover product session APIs. No request quota or rate-limit headers are specified.
